grammar.read: Open or receptive geometry, predominantly outline, movement inward. No solid marker.
grammar.write: A closed destination or committed terminal plus one solid orange consequence marker.
grammar.ring: Only where a context is genuinely held, bounded or switched.
grammar.rotation: Genuine counterparts are one composition under rotate(180 12 12), never a mirror.
grammar.selectedTab: Ground tint plus a deep-teal underline, carried by the container. Never orange.

icons.name: Pull LinkedIn info
icons.why: A wing receiving two signal arcs — lightweight extraction, nothing committed.

icons.name: Add to campaign
icons.why: Three wings rising on a diagonal — a flight formation — with the solid module at the top of the climb.

icons.name: Log sent
icons.why: A wing leaving a groundline. Its counterpart, Log reply, is this same composition rotated 180° — the operation that makes the mark’s second half from its first.

icons.name: Log reply
icons.why: Log sent under rotate(180 12 12). The pairing is enforced by the transform, so it cannot drift.

icons.name: Copy outreach prompt
icons.why: Two offset prompt cards. The wing enters as the back card’s top-right corner — two arcs meeting at a tip — so the brand sits in the fragment being copied, not in the metaphor.

icons.name: Add to action queue
icons.why: An ordered destination of three positions with the last one left open, and a solid module entering it from the right. Wide and striped, where Add to campaign rises diagonally.

icons.name: Log a call outcome
icons.why: A conventional handset, untouched, plus one closed outcome node. The node is the only committed mass in the glyph, which is what makes it a log rather than a dial.

icons.name: Import LinkedIn dossier
icons.why: A bounded document receiving one contained bundle across a dashed boundary. Pull LinkedIn info stays a light extraction; this is a block of material crossing into the record.

icons.name: Worklist
icons.why: A spine with three ordered veins reading top to bottom, all angled the same way so the structure stays a list rather than a plant. The single filled node marks the active position.

icons.name: Draft
icons.why: A page whose contour is deliberately unfinished at the bottom-right, with the second rule stopping short. Mid-change stated by the geometry, with no pencil to confuse with Edit.

icons.name: Draft
icons.why: The same idea on a message form rather than a page: the bubble’s lower run and tail are left open. Reads more clearly as unsent outreach, less clearly as a document.

icons.name: Chat
icons.why: Two speech forms related by 180° rotation, holding a diagonal band of negative space between two perspectives. The clearest expression of the construction rule in the set, and no ring, so it never becomes the logo.

icons.name: Today
icons.why: A bounded day inside a conventional calendar. One emphatic present-day node, deep teal rather than orange, since arriving at today spends nothing.

icons.name: Log
icons.why: A straight vertical path with three deposited nodes and rules that shorten as they recede. Settled past, where Worklist points at pending action.

icons.name: Credit balance
icons.why: A segmented meter: five finite positions, three remaining. Restrained enough to sit at 14px beside the numeral without competing with it.

icons.name: Credit balance
icons.why: Four compact units, three spent. Counts rather than measures, which suits a balance that moves in whole credits, and holds its shape better than a meter at 14px.

icons.name: Workspace switcher
icons.why: The mark’s own arrangement at icon scale: two wings in the held ring, rotationally paired. Teal and deep teal only — identity is carried by the geometry, and orange stays available for a warning.

icons.name: Workspace switcher
icons.why: Two arcs related by 180° rotation, each with a committed terminal, turning around the held context in the centre. The switch is the rotation, so the whole context visibly changes rather than being colour-coded.

icons.name: Fields
icons.why: A wing at tab scale with two short keyed strokes reading into it — the record’s stored values, received rather than written.

icons.name: Credit balance — low balance
icons.why: Orange enters the credit component only when the balance is nearly spent, so the colour keeps its meaning as consequence.
